preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address
Contract must have BNB balance in its treasury

exploit_hint: As owner or authorized address, call clearStuckBalance() with 100% parameter to drain all BNB from contract to marketingFeeReceiver (which can be set to attacker's address via setFeeReceivers()). Alternatively, use manualSend() to transfer all BNB to marketingFeeReceiver. First ensure marketingFeeReceiver is set to attacker's address using setFeeReceivers() function.
